page: Microsoft Azure EC16ads_v6 is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the ECadsv6 family. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs powered by an AMD processor and runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU.

For storage needs, the EC16ads_v6 includes 614 GB of local disk capacity and is Premium Storage capable, allowing for integration with high-performance external storage volumes. The instance does not bundle complimentary public IPv4 addresses, and no discrete GPU hardware is present on this server configuration.

With its 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this instance offers a memory-optimized hardware profile. This resource density makes it qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads requiring significant memory capacity relative to compute cores without the overhead of unneeded virtual CPUs. The combination of dedicated AMD execution threads, substantial memory, and local storage capacity makes the EC16ads_v6 suitable for memory-intensive workloads, database hosting, enterprise applications, and data caching layers.
